visual_connections.description: Satellite imagery feeds into EC2 Spot instances for processing.
EC2 Spot writes processed imagery bulk data into S3.
EC2 Spot writes imagery metadata into RDS.
Fargate queries RDS for image metadata corresponding to requested map tiles.
Fargate retrieves image chunks using HTTP range requests from S3.
Fargate reads and writes generated map tiles to ElastiCache.
Users request and receive map tiles from Fargate.
Lambda queries RDS for imagery metadata.
Lambda fetches source imagery from S3 to compute time series.
Farmer field boundaries and parameters are sent to Lambda for time-series computation.
